name: claude-token-guard
description: Status bar badge with Claude Code 5-hour session usage that shifts from green to red as it nears your limit.

tokenGuard.limitPercent.description: Usage percent at which the badge turns red. Color shifts from green to red as usage nears this value.

tokenGuard.claudeConfigDir.description: Claude Code config folder (e.g. ~/.claude-personal). Empty: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR from claudeCode.environmentVariables, then from the VS Code launch environment, then the default Claude Code location.

tokenGuard.refreshSeconds.description: How often to refresh usage in the background by running `claude -p /usage` (no model call, 0 tokens). Minimum 60. 0 turns auto refresh off.

tokenGuard.claudePath.description: Path to the claude binary used for refresh. Empty: the binary bundled with the Claude Code extension, else `claude` from PATH.
